title: Hands To Yourself
description: Controls how your hand and camera overlays visible, not hidden from HUD.
body:
# Hands To Yourself Hands To Yourself separates your hand and camera overlays (like vingette) to not be hidden from the "Toggle GUI" (F1) button and make them as their own buttons. Great for making first person cinematic shots! ![Keybinds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7b773191a9ad06e3fcc4845cfb7c502e90a39696.png) F7 - Show/hide camera overlays F8 - Show/hide hand ![Feature](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9spp6vde/images/bc571fef820eb5240334d7487cf93beba5d59a82_350.webp) ### Special Credit Credit to this old relic that has never been updated. This mod would (probably) not exist because of it.
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/removehudbutnothand
